e.title: Insurance-Skills
e.summary: 复旦许闲团队开源保险业 Skill 平台：核保/理赔/客服等场景技能汇聚、评测与复用
e.body: Insurance-Skills 是复旦大学许闲教授团队发起的保险领域开源 Skill 基础设施平台（Apache 2.0，v1.0.0）：把核保规则、理赔流程、客服话术等场景能力封装成标准化 Skill，支持多维评测与工程化复用，体验地址 skills.fduinsurance.com。对培训课：行业真实场景 skill 的现成案例库；与 [[actuarial-skills]] 组成「精算 + 保险业务」技能生态，关联 [[fraud-detection]] 等词条。 核保岗位（[[underwriter]]）是保险实务的核心角色。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：README 完整阅读（平台定位/四大难题/能力底座），未实测
e.summary_en: Fudan Prof. Xu Xian's open-source insurance Skill platform: underwriting/claims/service skills, evaluation & reuse
e.summary_hk: 復旦許閒團隊開源保險業 Skill 平台：核保/理賠/客服等場景技能匯聚、評測與復用
e.body_en: Insurance-Skills is an open-source insurance-domain Skill infrastructure platform (Apache 2.0, v1.0.0) led by Prof. Xu Xian's team at Fudan University: packaging underwriting rules, claims processes and service scripts into standardized Skills with multi-dimensional evaluation and engineering reuse; experience at skills.fduinsurance.com. For training sessions: a ready-made case library of real insurance-scenario skills; together with [[actuarial-skills]] it forms an actuarial + insurance-business skill ecosystem, related to entries such as [[fraud-detection]]. The underwriting role ([[underwriter]]) is central to insurance practice.
e.body_hk: Insurance-Skills 是復旦大學許閒教授團隊發起的保險領域開源 Skill 基礎設施平台（Apache 2.0，v1.0.0）：把核保規則、理賠流程、客服話術等場景能力封裝成標準化 Skill，支持多維評測與工程化復用，體驗地址 skills.fduinsurance.com。對培訓課：行業真實場景 skill 的現成案例庫；與 [[actuarial-skills]] 組成「精算 + 保險業務」技能生態，關聯 [[fraud-detection]] 等詞條。 核保崗位（[[underwriter]]）是保險實務的核心角色。
